basis: Dai explicitly selected public Internet crawler/search only.
permitted_candidate_discovery: One bounded public search result page per declared new source/month, domain and date filters only, may serve as discovery when official monthly enumeration is unavailable; no climate/emotion/length terms.
frame_must_record: Search provider, exact query/date filter, observation timestamp, observed links and page limit; not an official monthly publication census.
first_publication: Search index dates/snippets and URL dates remain candidates. Each fetched article must independently match the declared month with actual first-publication evidence; updated/indexed dates are not substitutions.
selection: First five stable unique eligible native article URLs in the declared partial frame; unknown pi, no denominator inference; no unlimited search/pagination.
limits: Same original months/150cap/30per region/5per source-month, old known source halts preserved, no content/rights bypass; exact execution candidate still requires one acceptance.
